import json
import numpy as np

def compute_ece(probs, labels, n_bins=10):
    bin_boundaries = np.linspace(0, 1, n_bins + 1)
    ece = 0.0
    mce = 0.0
    for i in range(n_bins):
        mask = (probs > bin_boundaries[i]) & (probs <= bin_boundaries[i+1])
        if mask.sum() == 0:
            continue
        bin_acc = labels[mask].mean()
        bin_conf = probs[mask].mean()
        bin_size = mask.sum() / len(probs)
        gap = abs(bin_acc - bin_conf)
        ece += gap * bin_size
        mce = max(mce, gap)
    return ece, mce

def compute_brier(probs, labels):

# === Regex Baselines ===

def b_marker(input_text):
    """检测 [No exception data in trace] → pass, else → fail"""
    if "[No exception data in trace]" in input_text:
        return "pass"
    return "fail"

def b_error(input_text):
    """检测 [ERROR] → fail, else → pass"""
    if "[ERROR]" in input_text:
        return "fail"
    return "pass"

def b_optimal(input_text):
    """最优组合 regex"""
    # 尝试多种 pattern 组合
    if "[No exception data in trace]" in input_text:
        return "pass"
    if re.search(r'(Error|Exception|Traceback)', input_text):
        return "fail"
    return "pass"  # 或 fail，取决于哪种更优

# === 评估 ===
def evaluate(predictions, labels):
    correct = sum(p == l for p, l in zip(predictions, labels))
    acc = correct / len(labels)
    # Per-class P/R/F1
    for cls in ["pass", "fail"]:
        tp = sum(p == cls and l == cls for p, l in zip(predictions, labels))
        fp = sum(p == cls and l != cls for p, l in zip(predictions, labels))
        fn = sum(p != cls and l == cls for p, l in zip(predictions, labels))
        prec = tp / (tp + fp) if (tp + fp) > 0 else 0
        rec = tp / (tp + fn) if (tp + fn) > 0 else 0
        f1 = 2 * prec * rec / (prec + rec) if (prec + rec) > 0 else 0
        print(f"  {cls}: P={prec:.4f} R={rec:.4f} F1={f1:.4f}")
    return acc

# === McNemar discordant pairs ===
def mcnemar(sft_preds, regex_preds, labels):
    """SFT correct & regex wrong vs SFT wrong & regex correct"""
    sft_correct_regex_wrong = 0
    sft_wrong_regex_correct = 0
    for s, r, l in zip(sft_preds, regex_preds, labels):
        sc = (s == l)
        rc = (r == l)
        if sc and not rc:
            sft_correct_regex_wrong += 1
        if rc and not sc:
            sft_wrong_regex_correct += 1
    return sft_correct_regex_wrong, sft_wrong_regex_correct
